name: Karelian Heritage Shungite
desc: Shungite — the black, carbon-rich mineraloid that only forms in one place on the planet: the Zazhoginskoye deposit in Karelia, Russia. Two billion years old, contains naturally occurring fullerenes (the C60 carbon structures Buckminster Fuller predicted and Kroto won the Nobel for), and used in the surrounding villages for centuries to purify drinking water from the spring. Modern interest centres on three uses. ONE — water purification: raw shungite stones dropped into a jug strip chlorine, heavy metals, and microbial load, and infuse the water with fullerene-bound trace minerals. Refresh the stones monthly in sunlight. TWO — EMF shielding: shungite plates on phones and laptops, room cubes near routers, pyramids in bedrooms. The grounding stone of the EMF era. THREE — wearable: pendants and bracelets, kept on the body. Karelian Heritage is the cleanest source — family-run, Russia-direct, lab-tested for authenticity (the market is full of black-rock fakes), full traceability back to the Karelian deposit. Raw, polished, pendants, water sets, cubes, pyramids — full catalogue from a single source.
